CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spotify_scrobbles (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  played_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  track_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  track_uri TEXT,
  track_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  artists JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  album TEXT,
  duration_ms INT,
  progress_ms INT,
  device_name TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spotify_scrobbles_played_at ON spotify_scrobbles (played_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spotify_scrobbles_track_id ON spotify_scrobbles (track_id);

WITH p AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j
)
INSERT INTO spotify_scrobbles (
  played_at, track_id, track_uri, track_name, artists, album, duration_ms, progress_ms, device_name
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((p.j->>'playedAt')::timestamptz, NOW()),
  p.j->>'trackId',
  p.j->>'trackUri',
  p.j->>'trackName',
  COALESCE(p.j->'artists', '[]'::jsonb),
  p.j->>'album',
  (p.j->>'durationMs')::int,
  (p.j->>'progressMs')::int,
  p.j->>'deviceName'
FROM p
RETURNING id, track_name, played_at;
